caching.title: Caching
caching.pageDescription: Cache responses locally with two complementary lookup paths: direct hash matching for exact replays, and semantic similarity search for related content. Send the x-bf-cache-key header to scope cached responses to a tenant or feature.
caching.requiresVectorStore: Requires a vector store to be configured and enabled in config.json.
caching.unexpectedError: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
caching.enableCachingDesc: Loads (or unloads) the plugin without a server restart. Configuration changes you make below mutate the live plugin in place, no redeploy needed.
caching.embeddingRequired: Configure an embedding-capable provider to enable semantic mode.
caching.directModeDesc: Direct-only mode hashes each request and replays an exact match. No embeddings, no provider needed. Cheapest path, perfect for stable prompts.
caching.semanticModeDesc: Direct + semantic mode adds vector similarity search on top of direct hash matching. Requires an embedding-capable provider and the model's real dimension. Direct hits are still served first; semantic search runs only when the direct lookup misses.
caching.searchModel: Search or type an embedding model...
caching.apiKeysInherited: API keys are inherited from the embedding provider's main configuration, you don't need to add them again here.
caching.dimensionDesc: Vector size produced by the embedding model. Must match the model exactly (e.g. 1536 for OpenAI text-embedding-3-small, 3072 for text-embedding-3-large, 768 for many Cohere/Voyage models).
caching.headsUp: Heads up: a vector store namespace can only hold vectors of one dimension. Whenever you change the embedding provider, model, or dimension, make sure the dimension still matches what the model produces, otherwise writes to the existing namespace will fail and reads will silently miss. The namespace is not recreated automatically; either use a fresh namespace or drop the existing class/index in your vector store before saving.
caching.ttlDesc: How long cached entries live before they expire. Override per-request via the x-bf-cache-ttl header.
caching.thresholdDesc: Minimum cosine similarity for a semantic hit. Override per-request via x-bf-cache-threshold.
caching.namespaceDesc: Bucket/index name where cache entries live. Leave blank to use the default (BifrostLocalCachePlugin). Changing this points the plugin at a different (possibly empty) bucket. Old entries are not deleted, they just stop being queried.
caching.cacheKeyDesc: Fallback partition key used when a request doesn't set x-bf-cache-key. Cache keys isolate entries: same key ↔ shared cache pool. Leave blank to disable caching for any request that doesn't send the header.
caching.conversationThresholdDesc: Skip caching for conversations with more than this many messages. Long histories rarely match exactly and inflate the cache without paying off.
caching.excludeSystemPromptDesc: Strip system messages from the cache key.
caching.cacheByModelDesc: Include model name in the cache key. Different models won't share cached responses.
caching.cacheByProviderDesc: Include provider name in the cache key. Different providers won't share cached responses.
caching.overrideKey: x-bf-cache-key: scope this request to a specific cache partition.
caching.overrideTtl: x-bf-cache-ttl: override TTL for just this request.
caching.overrideThreshold: x-bf-cache-threshold: override the semantic similarity threshold.
caching.overrideType: x-bf-cache-type: send direct or semantic to limit lookup to one path.
caching.overrideNoStore: x-bf-cache-no-store: true to skip writing the response (still serves cached hits).

validation.providerRequired: Pick an embedding provider for semantic mode, or switch to Direct only.
validation.modelRequired: Pick an embedding model for semantic mode.
validation.dimensionRequired: Semantic mode requires the embedding model's real dimension (must be > 1).
validation.thresholdRange: Similarity threshold must be between 0 and 1.
validation.conversationThresholdRange: Conversation history threshold must be between 1 and 50.

clientSettings.title: Client Settings
clientSettings.dropExcessRequestsDesc: If enabled, pg-gateway will drop requests that exceed pool capacity.
clientSettings.droppedRequests: Have dropped <1>{{count}} requests</1> since last restart.
clientSettings.disableDbPings: Disable DB Pings in Health Check
clientSettings.disableDbPingsDesc: If enabled, the /health endpoint will skip database connectivity checks and return OK immediately.
clientSettings.dumpErrorsDesc: If enabled, full error details are written to the server console logs. Useful for debugging, but may be noisy in production.
clientSettings.asyncJobResultTtlDesc: Default time-to-live for async job results in seconds. Results are automatically cleaned up after expiry.
clientSettings.headerForwardingDesc: Control which extra headers are forwarded to LLM providers.
clientSettings.prefixedHeadersDesc: Use <1>x-bf-eh-*</1> prefix. For example, <3>x-bf-eh-custom-id</3> is forwarded as <5>custom-id</5>.
clientSettings.directHeadersDesc: Any header explicitly added to the allowlist can be forwarded directly without the prefix (e.g., <1>anthropic-beta</1>).
clientSettings.allowlistEmptyDesc: Only <1>x-bf-eh-*</1> prefixed headers are forwarded (default behavior)
clientSettings.allowlistConfiguredDesc: Prefixed headers filtered by allowlist, plus any direct header in the allowlist is forwarded
clientSettings.denylistRuleDesc: Headers in the denylist are always blocked from forwarding
clientSettings.wildcardsDesc: Use <1>*</1> at the end of a pattern to match prefixes (e.g., <3>anthropic-*</3> matches all headers starting with <5>anthropic-</5>). Use <7>*</7> alone to match all headers.
clientSettings.importantDesc1: Allowlist/denylist entries should be the header name <1>without</1> the <3>x-bf-eh-</3> prefix
clientSettings.importantDesc2: Example: To allow <1>x-bf-eh-custom-id</1> or direct <3>custom-id</3>, add <5>custom-id</5> to the allowlist
clientSettings.securityNoteDesc: Some headers are always blocked for security reasons regardless of configuration. These headers cannot be added to the allowlist or denylist:
clientSettings.allowlistDesc: Headers to allow. Enter names without the <1>x-bf-eh-</1> prefix. Any header in this list can also be sent directly without the prefix.
clientSettings.denylistDesc: Headers to block. Enter names without the <1>x-bf-eh-</1> prefix. Applies to both prefixed and direct header forwarding.
clientSettings.configNotLoaded: Configuration not loaded. Please refresh and try again.

logging.title: Logging
logging.enableLogsDesc: Enable logging of requests and responses to a SQL database. This can add 40-60mb of overhead to the system memory.
logging.requiresLogsStore: Requires logs store to be configured and enabled in config.json.
logging.disableContentLoggingDesc: When enabled, only usage metadata (latency, cost, token count, status, routing IDs, etc.) is logged. Request/response content (messages, params, tool calls, and any raw provider bytes) is dropped from log records, even when <1>store_raw_request_response</1> is on. Raw-byte send-back to callers via <3>send_back_raw_*</3> is unaffected.
logging.retainContentInObjectStorageDesc: When enabled, requests with content logging disabled (via the global setting above or the <1>x-bf-disable-content-logging</1> header) still have their full content offloaded to object storage, but the content is never shown in logs: the database row stays metadata-only and the UI/API never fetch the payload back. Content is then only readable with direct access to the storage bucket. When disabled, content for such requests is dropped entirely (current behavior).
logging.requiresObjectStorage: Requires object storage to be configured on the logs store in config.json.
logging.allowPerRequestContentStorageOverrideDes: When enabled, individual requests can override the global content logging setting using the <1>x-bf-disable-content-logging</1> header or context key, and can opt-in to persisting raw provider bytes in logs using the <3>x-bf-store-raw-request-response</3> header. Raw-byte storage requires content logging to be on, either globally, or via <5>x-bf-disable-content-logging: false</5> on the same request. If content logging is off, raw bytes are dropped from the log record even when <7>x-bf-store-raw-request-response: true</7>. Does not control sending raw bytes back to callers; see Allow Per-Request Raw Override.
logging.allowPerRequestRawOverrideDesc: When enabled, individual requests can send raw provider request/response bytes back to the caller using the <1>x-bf-send-back-raw-request</1> and <3>x-bf-send-back-raw-response</3> headers. Does not affect log storage; raw-byte persistence in logs is controlled by Allow Per-Request Content Storage Override.
logging.logRetentionDaysDesc: Number of days to retain logs in the database. Minimum is 1 day. Older logs will be automatically deleted.
logging.hideDeletedVirtualKeys: Do Not Show Deleted VirtualKeys In Filters
logging.hideDeletedVirtualKeysDesc: When enabled, deleted virtual keys are excluded from Virtual Keys filter options in Logs, Dashboard, and MCP Logs.
logging.loggingHeadersDesc: Comma-separated list of request headers to capture in log metadata. Supports exact names and wildcard patterns (e.g. <1>x-custom-*</1> captures all headers with that prefix, <3>*</3> logs all headers; note that <5>*</5> will capture sensitive headers like Authorization). Values are extracted from incoming requests and stored in the metadata field of log entries. Headers with the <7>x-bf-lh-</7> prefix are always captured automatically.
logging.restartWarning: Need to restart pg-gateway to apply changes.

security.title: Security
security.pageDescription: Control who can open the dashboard and who is allowed to call your AI models.
security.passwordProtectDesc: Require a username and password to open the dashboard. Turn this on so only people you trust can see or change settings.
security.passwordHint: Use at least 12 characters with uppercase, lowercase, number, and special character. Env var references are accepted.
security.setupTokenCliTitle: Use the CLI to create the first admin account
security.setupTokenCliDesc: This instance doesn't have an admin account yet. Create one with the bundled CLI — you only need shell access to the container. After it's created, refresh this page to manage auth normally.
security.enforceVirtualKeysDesc: Require every API request to include a valid virtual key. Turn this on to block unauthorized callers from using your models — recommended for production.
security.allowDirectKeysDesc: Let callers send their own provider API key with each request (for example while testing), instead of using a key you have registered. Safe to leave off if you're the only user.
security.allowedOriginsDesc: Which websites and browser apps are allowed to call this gateway from a browser. Add one URL per line or separate with commas. Your own computer (localhost) is always allowed. Use * only if you want to open the gateway to every origin.
security.allowedOriginsExample: Example: https://myapp.com, https://admin.myapp.com, or * to allow all
security.allowedHeadersDesc: Which extra HTTP headers your apps are allowed to send. Most setups can leave this empty.
security.allowedHeadersExample: Example: X-Request-ID or any header your app sends
security.requiredHeadersDesc: Headers that every request must include (for example a tenant ID). Requests that miss them are rejected automatically. Leave empty unless you need this.
security.whitelistedRoutesDesc: URL paths that don't need authentication — useful for public endpoints like webhooks. System health checks are always allowed.
security.invalidOrigins: Invalid origin(s): {{origins}}. Each entry must be a full URL like https://example.com, a wildcard like https://*.example.com, or * to allow all.
security.restartWarning: Need to restart pg-gateway to apply changes.

proxy.scimDesc: Use proxy for SCIM directory sync requests.
